name: 2026 Small Grants for Watershed Education and Stewardship

funder.name: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation Hudson River Estuary Program

summary: Small grants for community-led Hudson River Estuary watershed outreach, education and stewardship projects that support clean water and healthy tributaries goals.

geography.label: Hudson River Estuary Management Program boundaries

reporting: Final report with public event details, photos where applicable, testimonials and copies of project products.

status.quote: is pleased to announce a Request for Proposals (RFP) for projects that will directly support the Clean Hudson River Water and Healthy Tributaries goals of the Hudson River Estuary Action Agenda 2026-2030.

deadline.quote: Proposals due to NEIWPCC By 4:00 PM December 4, 2026

administered_by.quote: The NYS DEC Hudson River Estuary Management Program ("Estuary Program") in coordination with the New England Interstate Water Pollution Control Commission ("NEIWPCC"), is pleased to announce a Request for Proposals

applicant_types.quote: Potential applicants may include: • Colleges and universities, • K-12 schools, • Nonprofit organizations, • Local watershed groups, • NY Soil and Water Conservation Districts, • Municipal or county governments or agencies

geography.quote: Applicants must be located within the Hudson River Estuary Management Program boundaries

access.quote: Applicants may submit proposals as part of a collaborative team comprising multiple organizations. However, each proposal must identify a single organization or individual as the primary applicant.

window.quote: Anticipated Project Timeline Successful applicants will complete projects according to the following schedule

amount.quote: Approximately $50,000 in funding is available to support awarded projects. Grants of between $1,000 to $10,000 will be awarded.

pool.quote: Approximately $50,000 in funding is available to support awarded projects. Grants of between $1,000 to $10,000 will be awarded.

co_finance_required.quote: In-kind or cash match is not required.

reporting.quote: Required Project Deliverables • A final report describing all work completed under the grant.
